scope: CPU-only mature-state mechanism diagnosis; no new training, production reset, or capability conclusion from this short sample

hypotheses.write: STP-depleted sensory neurons can produce different spikes yet send substantially attenuated pulses. Measure the exact pulse multiplier on neurons whose spike decisions differ; do not infer task information from amplitude.
hypotheses.clock: If the normal read event is too early, quiet continuation must produce stronger motor and readable probability-direction responses. At the first quiet tick compare arrival A and conductance g, verifying delta_g=(1-rho_s)*delta_A when previous motor conductances agree.
hypotheses.read: If the read interface is the major bottleneck, motor contrasts are present but their relative/tangential differences become weak at R or RMSNorm. Decompose the actual R gradient on a single-head 32-event real window; separate common and covariance terms before Adam.

decision: Localize attenuation to write, arrival/filter timing, or read geometry before designing one repair. Reject reset-erasure and more-ticks-by-default claims without discriminating evidence. Timing/read responses alone do not prove useful next-token information.
independent_plan_review: diagnosis_review approves the two minimal measurements, requiring quiet subsequent input for the impulse response and one fixed head/state lineage for the real window
